prompt: Complete FileCopier.copy so it copies a file byte-for-byte from one path to another; the tests compare the raw bytes of source and target.
explanation: Files.copy performs an efficient byte-for-byte copy in one call; the REPLACE_EXISTING option keeps it from failing when the target already exists. The equivalent manual version reads with Files.readAllBytes and writes with Files.write, or streams a buffer in a loop for very large files. Either way the copy is exact -- no character decoding is involved, so it works for binary data.
hints: java.nio.file.Files has a ready-made copy(Path, Path, CopyOption...) method.
Pass StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING so a second copy to the same target does not throw.
Alternative: Files.write(to, Files.readAllBytes(from)) also copies every byte exactly.
